bias.en: Bearish · oversold, capped near $62 above the $58.4 April low
bias.zh: 看空 · 超卖，$62 附近受阻，守在 $58.4 四月低点上方

read.en: Intel rose 1.0% on Nov 3 to $60.55, trading between $59.87 and $62.59. It is far below the falling 5-day ($74.8), 10-day ($82.4), 30-day ($100.4) and 100-day ($103.8) and the rising 200-day ($87.0). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 5 and below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($93.61), and RSI is 24, oversold.
read.zh: 英特尔 11月3日上涨 1.0%，收于 $60.55，盘中区间 $59.87–62.59。股价远低于下行的 5 日（$74.8）、10 日（$82.4）、30 日（$100.4）和 100 日均线（$103.8）以及上行的 200 日均线（$87.0）。MACD 自 10月5日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$93.61），RSI 为 24，处于超卖。

read.en: The $62.59 high tested the $62.1–62.2 resistance and failed; the $58.4–59.4 support was not reached (Nov 3 low $59.87), so no written level changed. Resistance is $60.75–62.6 (April lows, Nov 3 high), then $63.2–65.7 and $68.3–68.8. Support is $58.4–59.9 (Apr 9 low, Nov 2–3 lows), then $54.8 (Apr 8 low) and $49.9–50. A close above $62.6 would target $65; below $58.4, $54.8.

r.en: Apr 10 low $60.75; Apr 13 and Apr 14 lows ($62.1–62.2); Nov 3 high $62.6
Oct 30 low $63.2, lost; Apr 20 and Apr 22 lows ($64.5–65.0); Nov 2 high $65.7

s.en: Apr 9 low $58.39; Nov 2 low $59.4; Nov 3 low $59.87
